text: dsh-ui-fortifier 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的界面增强插件，通过会话输入区、标题栏和设置页的 UI 插槽添加功能，并在插件卡片中提供六个独立开关。它可显示当前模型提供商、级联选择提供商与模型、复制会话 ID、确认后压缩上下文、拖动和缩放设置面板，以及打开本机 dshHome 文件夹。适合希望调整 DSH 网页操作体验的用户；源码未显示需要额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-ui-fortifier adds six optional controls to the DSH Web interface: a provider label and model picker, session ID copy, confirmed context compaction, adjustable settings, and a local dshHome folder button. The reviewed source shows no API key or external service requirement.
我想给 DSH 网页界面加一些可单独开关的操作和显示增强。
能不能在输入框旁边快速切换模型提供商和模型？
Can I add a button to copy the current session ID in the DSH web interface?
dsh-ui-fortifier 的功能「输入区模型选择」：在提供商标签旁提供级联模型选择器，可加载并搜索提供商和模型列表，选择后更新当前会话的模型。
dsh-ui-fortifier 的功能「压缩上下文按钮」：输入框工具行增加压缩按钮，点击后先显示确认气泡，确认时通过会话命令通道提交 /compact。

dsh-ui-fortifier README · dsh-ui-fortifier：[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-ui-fortifier)

[中文](./README.zh.md)

A DSH Web UI enhancer plugin

See [design/en/current.md](design/en/current.md) for details.

dsh-ui-fortifier README · Installation：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ui-fortifier
```

**Installing via GitHub is not supported.**
dsh-ui-fortifier README · Features：Adds a configuration area to this plugin's own card on the sidebar's Plugins page, toggling every feature module of this plugin.

dsh-ui-fortifier README · Features：| Feature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| session-id-copy | Copy-session-ID button in the Session header's utility group. |
| compact-button | Compact-context button at the right end of the composer tool row's left group; runs `/compact`. |
| provider-label | Shows the currently selected provider to the left of the model selector. |
| model-picker | Cascading model picker (provider → model) next to the model selector in the input row. |
| open-dsh-folder | Adds an "Open dshHome folder" button next to "Open configuration file" at the top-right of the Settings page. |
| settings-frame | Makes the Settings panel draggable and resizable. |
dsh-ui-fortifier README · dsh version used for development：- dsh version used for development: `0.1.7-rc.2`. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` dependencies use `workspace:^`.

dsh-ui-fortifier README · Secondary Development：Clone this repository into a dsh workspace package directory, then install and build:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/pgnqukezrdxmhjso/dsh-ui-fortifier packages/my/dsh-ui-fortifier
pnpm install
pnpm --filter dsh-ui-fortifier build
```

---

No runtime invariant companion is published because this package is a pure slot surface: it registers slots, a settings namespace, and one Remote endpoint, and owns no event stream or mutable state to assert.
